summary: V2.47.252 removes the obsolete BOOK_CATALOG import panel from the Courses frontend while preserving the legacy backend importer for compatibility. The Courses learning surface now stays focused on Add Course + package ZIP + Reader, and the empty-state copy no longer references import. No course data, schema, package storage, Reader, learning-state, auth, updater mechanism or Production semantics change. OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies; Owner Preview remains post-release and Production remains Owner-manual.
